label: seed weight
definition: A seed phenotype in which a(n) seed exhibits the quality weight.

label: seed increased weight
definition: A seed phenotype in which a(n) seed exhibits the quality increased weight.

label: seed decreased weight
definition: A seed phenotype in which a(n) seed exhibits the quality decreased weight.

label: seed normal weight
definition: A seed weight phenotype in which the weight of the seed is within the range normal for the taxon.
